description: Contact create, update, status change, delete and bulk delete through the HTTP routes record the acting user (actorType USER, actorId = req.user.id) on the ContactEvent and the ContactAuditEntry. System-context callers (the KEY adapter, automation-style CrmService calls, a system bulk delete) that pass no audit context record the SYSTEM actor on the ContactAuditEntry and attribute no user (a null actorId) on the ContactEvent, and (as of R0-13c-CT-PATCH-VISIBILITY) their update, status change and single delete events say actorType SYSTEM. Landed as R0-CT-03 at 87ca2b90 (d479fe67 tests first, db4ee154 fix, e448b8bd review repairs ST-1 reassign scope, ST-2 delete-once, ST-3 bulk traces). Run from apps/server against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/contacts-audit-actor.integration.test.ts test/crm.e2e.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-03-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/contacts-audit-actor.json --report .proof/r0-03-vitest.json. RED-BEFORE: these two test files on the unmodified source at 9c1163c1 fail 22 of 51: contacts-audit-actor 15 of 24 (all 11 NEGATIVE CONTROL cases, the three ST-1 positive controls, which assert the USER actor, and the repeat bulk delete) and crm.e2e 7 of 27 (actor forwarding on create, update and delete, the update-scoping and duplicate-409 spy assertions, and the handler-level 401). GREEN-AFTER (post-merge, exact head 6a754aee of pkt/R0-03-CT-AUDIT-ACTOR on claude/elegant-curie-7azpsb at ab8efa35; no source or test file changed): 51 of 51 passed, evaluate.mjs SATISFIED_AT_DECLARED_SCOPE. Unchanged since 9c1163c1 and green at the same head: contacts-visibility.integration 28/28, crm-contact-duplicate.integration 23/23. Review repairs (pkt/R0-03-CT-AUDIT-ACTOR-repair on 1d97b83a; no source file changed): contacts-audit-actor.integration.test.ts gained three it.todo review hand-offs (ST-A, ST-B, ST-C), each reproduced against the real database, whose fix was in crm.service.ts, outside that manifest-only write set. R0-13c-CT-PATCH-VISIBILITY fixed them and replaced the three todos with six required cases: ST-A, a crm 'write' STAFF member who gets 404 on GET for the owner's PRIVATE contact also gets 404 on PATCH {} and PATCH {jobTitle} with nothing written; ST-B, a PATCH reassignment to another tenant's user, an unknown id or '' is refused 400 with nothing written, for the owner and a crm_reassign STAFF member; ST-C, the KEY adapter update/status change and delete and the automation-shape update write actorType 'SYSTEM' (null actorId) on contact.updated, status.changed and contact.deleted, matching the SYSTEM audit entry, while the same edits through the HTTP routes keep recording the member as USER. RED-BEFORE at 13b7389a (tests-first commit b090af9a): the five NEGATIVE CONTROL cases among them fail (ST-A PATCH {} 200, ST-B 200, ST-C actorType 'USER'), all 24 earlier contacts-audit-actor cases pass. No case of either file is a todo any more; allowAdditionalCases stays true only because crm.e2e.test.ts, which this manifest also runs, is in the write set of later packets (V1-08-CT-SIBLING-VISIBILITY) that do not list this manifest. requireReportSuccess keeps the whole run binding.
